model.graph: two-site edge, four-site square face, and six-site 2x3 rectangular grid
model.cutoff: replace only bond coordinates by the smooth cosine cutoff q_L; W_L=H-H_L
model.triple_coefficient: T_L=[H,[W_L,[H,A_2]]], with D''(0)=-sigma*T_inner/hbar^2 and delta D''(0)=beta*T_L/hbar^2
model.weighted_norm: four-leg two-sided candidate: K^s X rho^(1/2), K^s X* rho^(1/2), X K^s rho^(1/2), X* K^s rho^(1/2), with s=3/4
model.weights: support-local K=I+H_{sites 0,1,bond(0,1)} and full-volume K=I+H, each shifted positive

no_overclaim: This is a finite actual-Q3 weighted triple-commutator stress test for one declared candidate energy topology. It does not prove a common-core bound, volume/source uniformity, positive-time history, direct D or delta-D Cauchy, common dynamics, OS/KMS/GNS identification, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure. Any observed growth is a route-local obstruction to this candidate weight only, not a no-go theorem for every possible Q3 topology.
